scope: Read-only inventory of JSON/JSONL outside browser profiles; no original files changed

detectionRules.game-save: dict with objects list, scripts dict, state dict (health/potions/score), and level string
detectionRules.save-wrapper: dict with game matching game-save plus level and position
detectionRules.export: dict with format, formatVersion, player, save matching save-wrapper
detectionRules.serialized: JSON strings parsed only if >= 200 characters and first nonspace character is { or [

recommendation: Delete standalone saves. For mixed reports replace payloads with metadata: removedSavePayload=true, serializedBytes, sha256, level, state summary, position if available, savedAt, objectCount. Preserve surrounding timings, event type, route steps, errors, checks and summaries. JSONL line numbers are 1-based. path uses exact object keys/list indexes; jsonStringSteps records any serialized container needing JSON.parse before applying descendant paths.
